component.name: Generic Player
component.summary: Play music and videos with an audio visualizer

description.p: Generic Player is a desktop music and video player with a searchable queue, album artwork, playback controls and configurable color themes.

Organize local files and HTTP or HTTPS media streams, import and export playlists, and resume your listening session. Spectrum and waveform views use decoded audio when the installed Qt Multimedia backend supports it.

MPRIS desktop media controls support playerctl and compatible tools. Optional song notifications show artist, title and known year. Automatic discovery supports existing GNOME, KDE and compatible desktop notification services and verified Wayland_OSD installations. Custom command adapters can be configured without making any OSD package a playback dependency.

Restore reliable P and Space playback shortcuts across player controls and fullscreen. Preserve text editing and menu navigation, accept separate rapid playback gestures, and retain optional OSD discovery and desktop media controls.

Automatically discover compatible Wayland OSD aliases and running desktop notification services, including GNOME and KDE. Add explicit custom command adapters, preserve saved notification preferences, and keep optional integration resources bounded.
Discover optional OSD installations at /usr/bin/osd and other supported locations, recover failed deliveries with an explicit retry, and bound asynchronous startup and notification resources.

Add native QtDBus media controls, preserved year and date metadata, and optional song notifications. Improve transport state handling and keep desktop notification services independent of installation.
Add audio visualization, an improved queue and listening view, reliable playback controls, source installation and desktop data.
